text: Heroku: sustaining engineering since 2026-02-06 (no new features, no official end date); slug limit 1000 MB; Scheduler minimum 10 minutes, so a 1-minute poller must be a worker. The owner plans for a Heroku sunset in April 2027 (10-12), so jobsnearme's phase C moves to AWS before then.

jobsnearme: until FS-383 (994867ad, 10-5), /demo bought Google Places photos on every load (~$3.1k from 9-23, mostly e2e); the demo photos now live in the repo and a test guard fails if places.googleapis.com appears in src.

jobsnearme: Next 16's build typecheck drops diagnostics for files under __tests__/ or __mocks__/ and *.test.*/*.spec.* (runTypeCheck.js ignoreRegex), so a test importing a route file the export scripts rename aside doesn't break build:pages/build:mobile.
jobsnearme dev corpus (10-5): 11,285 of 11,390 Juvo postings have jobType 'flexible' (part_and_full_time), so the schedule filter separates very few jobs.

jobsnearme: commute-cost hides the car cost once the committed gas price is over 21 days old; FS-438 (e6c88e84) refreshed it to EIA's 2026-10-05 week, so it goes stale around 2026-10-26 unless npm run fetch:fuel-price is run and shipped again.
jobsnearme: every e2e and full npm test run takes `lockf -k /tmp/jnm-certify.lock`; since FS-433 (57a2b909) each worktree has its own e2e ports, so never kill a server you didn't start.

for the next L3 session: every e2e run and full `npm test` takes `lockf -k /tmp/jnm-certify.lock`; iterate with `npx vitest related <files>`; one implementer per lane; ports are per-worktree since FS-433; record scope.head at build (FS-236).

jobsnearme corpus keeps Juvo ids: job_postings.source_key = Juvo job id, company_locations.source_key = Juvo location id (scripts/ingest-juvo-jobs.mjs:293-338, source_system='juvo'), enough to POST /api/v3/connections {company_location_id, job_ids} for the bridge.
